zh.heroTitle: 把心情与身体放在同一时间轴
zh.heroDesc: 小树日记将情绪记录与睡眠、心率、运动、正念等健康数据对齐展示，帮你更清晰地理解身体状态和当下感受。
zh.downloadCta: 前往 App Store 下载小树日记
zh.featuresSubtitle: 语音记录、健康联动、本地 AI 反馈
zh.featureTimelineDesc: 把当日心情与健康快照放在同一页面，快速看见情绪和身体节律之间的关系。
zh.featureVoiceDesc: 支持语音转写写入正文，记录更自然，降低每天写日记的门槛。
zh.featureContextDesc: 可结合睡眠、运动、正念等信息，减少手动记录，让内容更贴近真实一天。
zh.featureAiTitle: 🤝 本地 AI 镜像反馈
zh.featureAiDesc: 在支持机型上可使用设备端模型生成共情式摘要与视角提示，降低敏感内容上云顾虑。
zh.featureWeeklyDesc: 按周汇总关键模式与变化，帮助你更稳定地做复盘与自我观察。
zh.featurePrivacyDesc: 支持应用锁与列表模糊；健康与日记数据以本机存储为主，记录更安心。
zh.permissionsDesc: 使用相关功能前会说明用途，权限可随时在系统设置中关闭。
zh.disclaimerText: 本应用用于情绪与健康记录，不提供医疗诊断或治疗建议。

en.heroTitle: Put mood and body on one timeline
en.heroDesc: TreeletDiary aligns mood journaling with sleep, heart rate, workouts, and mindfulness so you can better understand how body rhythms connect with feelings.
en.downloadCta: Download TreeletDiary on the App Store
en.featuresSubtitle: Voice journaling, health context, and on-device AI
en.featureTimelineDesc: See daily mood and health snapshots in one place to spot connections between emotional and physical states.
en.featureVoiceDesc: Record by voice and transcribe into text for faster, lower-friction daily journaling.
en.featureContextDesc: Optionally combine sleep, workouts, and mindfulness data so entries reflect your real day with less manual work.
en.featureAiDesc: On supported devices, local models can provide empathetic summaries and perspective prompts with no forced cloud processing.
en.featureWeeklyDesc: Weekly summaries and simple comparisons help you review patterns and changes over time.
en.featurePrivacyDesc: App lock and list blur are supported; health and diary data are primarily stored on device.
en.permissionsDesc: Each permission is explained before use and can be turned off anytime in system settings.
en.disclaimerText: This app is for mood and health journaling and does not provide medical diagnosis or treatment advice.
